3.name: Spellcasting & Mage Hand Legerdemain (Arcane Trickster)
3.description: Cast Wizard spells (INT) and summon an invisible Mage Hand capable of stowing, retrieving, picking locks, and disarming traps remotely.

9.name: Magical Ambush (Arcane Trickster)
9.description: If you have the Invisible condition when casting a spell on your turn, targets have Disadvantage on their first saving throw against it.

13.name: Versatile Trickster (Arcane Trickster)
13.description: When you use the Trip Cunning Strike option, your Mage Hand can distract another nearby target to trigger Sneak Attack.

17.name: Spell Thief (Arcane Trickster)
17.description: When targeted by a spell, use your Reaction to negate its effect on you and steal the knowledge to cast it for 8 hours (once per Long Rest).

3.name: Assassinate & Assassin's Tools (Assassin)
3.description: Gain Advantage on Initiative and first-round attacks against creatures that haven't acted (with extra Rogue-level damage on Sneak Attack), plus Disguise and Poisoner's Kit proficiency.

9.name: Infiltration Expertise (Assassin)
9.description: Adopt convincing false identities via Masterful Mimicry and move at normal speed while maintaining Advantage on attack rolls with Steady Aim.

13.name: Envenom Weapons (Assassin)
13.description: When using the Poison Cunning Strike option, the target takes an extra 2d6 Poison damage ignoring Poison Resistance.

17.name: Death Strike (Assassin)
17.description: Targets hit on the first round of combat must make a CON save or suffer doubled damage from that attack.

assassinate.name: Assassinate
assassinate.hint: Advantage on Initiative and first-round attacks vs creatures that haven't acted, adding Rogue level extra damage on Sneak Attack.

3.name: Psionic Power & Psychic Blades (Soulknife)
3.description: Gain Psionic Energy Dice (d6) for Psi-Bolstered Knack and Psychic Whispers, and manifest melee or thrown Psychic Blades dealing Psychic damage.

9.name: Soul Blades (Soulknife)
9.description: Spend a Psionic Energy Die for Homing Strikes (+die to missed Psychic Blade attack) or Psychic Teleportation (teleport 10x die feet as a Bonus Action).

13.name: Psychic Veil (Soulknife)
13.description: Become Invisible for 1 hour as a Magic action (once per Long Rest or by expending a Psionic Energy Die).

17.name: Rend Mind (Soulknife)
17.description: Force a target damaged by Psychic Blades Sneak Attack to succeed on a WIS save or be Stunned for 1 minute (once per Long Rest or 3 Psionic Dice).

psychic_blades.name: Psychic Blades
psychic_blades.hint: Manifest a Psychic Blade (1d6 Psychic, Finesse/Thrown 60 ft) plus Bonus Action second blade (1d4 Psychic).

psionic_energy_dice.name: Psionic Energy Die
psionic_energy_dice.hint: Roll to bolster failed skill checks (Psi-Bolstered Knack) or fuel Homing Strikes / Psychic Teleportation.

3.name: Fast Hands & Second-Story Work (Thief)
3.description: Use your Cunning Action Bonus Action to make Sleight of Hand checks, use Thieves' Tools, or take the Utilize/Magic action with an item, and gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

9.name: Supreme Sneak (Thief)
9.description: Use the Stealth Attack Cunning Strike option (1d6) to remain Hidden after attacking if you end your turn behind Three-Quarters or Total Cover.

13.name: Use Magic Device (Thief)
13.description: Attune to up to four magic items, occasionally expend charges without draining them (on a 6 on 1d6), and use any Spell Scroll.

17.name: Thief's Reflexes (Thief)
17.description: Take two turns during the first round of any combat (the second at your Initiative minus 10).
